question: Are the clinical enrolment, conditions, measurements and source gaps correct, and does any add a useful new EMC contribution?
approach: Independent cached primary-JATS/DOCX/text supplement review. All21original exports and42cache hashes, sevenprimary identity/eligibility anchors, all16Cnovyi baseline and8aggregate-response rows, all7Tazpaired-biopsy labels verified. No downloads, graphics or growth/efficacy calculations.
finding: Shelving is supported after one additive clarification batch. Actual author-labelled EMC enrolment differs from trial eligibility and generic myxoid chondrosarcoma. The sources do not supply a linked, dated, uniformly exposed separate-lesion EMC contrast beyond prior art. Assigned selumetinib125mg/pembrolizumab200mg cohort is source context; actual delivered exposure and outcome remain unlinked.
strongest_limits: Public graphics remain accessible but uninspected during the ban. Request-only or unlocated individual donor/lesion/date/exposure records are not established publicly accessible. Generic diagnoses, unknown molecular confirmation/wider donor overlap and pooled outcomes limit interpretation. No absence, inefficacy or exhaustion inference.
correction: Accepted source-condition amendment distinguishes availability, preserves assigned protocol cohorts and generic labels, and separates known same2trabectedin cases from wider unknown overlap. Source constraints are retained: maintenanceEMC best response lies within{PR,SD}; Cnovyi genericmyxoid cohort2 participant shares reported dead status with all4cohort members. scientific_value: Recovering a roster, assigned cohort or published best response does not by itself create new disease knowledge. Clinical outcomes and eligibility do not prove pathway dependence. Even future graphic recovery needs complete authentic identities/conditions, lesion-date-exposure linkage, adequate comparison and consequential unanswered value.
decision: ENDORSE shelving of this specific question. No new publication-worthy finding; campaign continues and suitable pending public evidence blocks promotion.
reopening: Authentic linked serial separate-lesion measurements, complete relevant public EMC coverage, exposure/overlap control and informative comparison; discriminating follow-through, validity/value review and independent challenge.
